relationships.subject: DRG Iba1+ macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: The accumulation and activation of macrophages in the DRG may account for the increased frequency and severity of autotomy in Wistar rats.

relationships.subject: NF200+ DRG neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that myelinated A fiber (NF200+) neurons may contribute to autotomy rather than small/medium peptidergic (CGRP+) neurons.

relationships.subject: DRG Iba1+ macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: The mean number of Iba1+ cells around the NF200+ neuron in the DRG of Wistar rat was higher than nude rats both at 6 (2.8 ± 0.29 vs. 1.6 ± 0.22, p < 0.05) and 12 (2.2 ± 0.18 vs. 1.5 ± 0.24, p < 0.05) weeks.

key_findings: Wistar rats showed more frequent and severe autotomy, more Iba1+ macrophages and more NF200+ neurons in DRG than nude rats after sciatic nerve repair; CGRP+ neuron proportion did not differ.
Macrophages clustered around NF200+ not CGRP+ neurons; no CD4+ T cells in DRG at 6 or 12 weeks.
